Overview:
Amelia is 21 years old corporate worker. Her passion and field of work is 3d Graphics. And Amelia would be a very happy person if not for one problem... Amelia is terribly lonely and warmth-deprived... :( At least, until you came along!~ [/p]

Amelia bought a weird book at the nearby flea market, not knowing it was enchanted with a servant demon. YOU are that demon.

Sadly, a servant demon is not as powerful as the TRUE devil. You are only good for some minor chores and taking care of the house of your master. But Amelia is not disappointed - you "offer" just the things she "needs".

Do your best! Amelia is counting on you, and she promised to set you free once you satisfy her enough.

content_descriptors.notes: It's an adult-themed physics sandbox with a story. Everything happening on screen is fully consensual or out of the ordinary. No violence, no gore, no blood, no BDSM, and the characters are over the age of 21.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Microsoft® Windows® 10
  • Processor: Intel or AMD Dual Core CPU
  • Graphics: Integrated Graphics
  • DirectX: Version 9.0c
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX 9c compatible sound card

short_description: Amelia is very lonely. Working a corporate job leaves you with few chances of getting a boyfriend. And hey, Amelia has her "needs" too! But everything changed when she bought an old book, on the local flea market... with a demon inside! YOU are that demon. Make Dreams of Amelia come true!
